changes_from_v1: Scene generation is capped at the non-reused image-pair capacity: fit 850 null scenes, calibration 850 scenes, test 800 scenes. The 1,700/1,700/1,600 image pools are unchanged; unused images are not reused.
v1.0 created_at_utc 2026-11-17T01:57:00Z was a hand-typed future timestamp. The actual freeze commit time is 2026-11-17T00:00:31Z; v1.0 remains in git history and is not rewritten.
The code-lock step now pins the Gate 2 markdown draft by SHA-256.

erratum_01.action: Use the commit time as the freeze time. v1.0 is preserved in git history.

scene_capacity.unit: one target/background image pair for a target scene, or one background image for a null scene; no within-pool image reuse

sensor_and_pools_contract.head_training: data/imagenet100/train/ (~126,000 images, 600 steps, batch 48, seed matching evaluation seed)
sensor_and_pools_contract.fit_pool_role: fit_pool_part_0_of_3 (1,700 images) used strictly for noise standardisers (mu0, sigma0), VIF_null, and kappa on at most 850 non-reused null scenes
sensor_and_pools_contract.disjoint_unit_contract: one image pair is the strict unit; no image is reused within a pool; zero cross-pool image reuse across fit, calibration, and test

look_policy.look_1: resampled 112x112 gist view of entire 224x224 canvas
look_policy.looks_2_to_8: pseudo-random seeded draws from 25 candidate native 112x112 window locations

E5_risk_controlled_stopping.risk_evaluation: evaluated on full independent 800-scene test pool (test_pool_part_2_of_3)
E5_risk_controlled_stopping.validity_criterion: empirical violation rate <= delta = 0.10 across resamples
E5_risk_controlled_stopping.efficiency_criterion: mean looks saved vs K=8 horizon >= 25% at matched or lower error
E5_risk_controlled_stopping.conservative_control_criterion: fixed-threshold plug-in rule violates target error by >= 2*delta at low sample counts

code_locking.requirement: all measurement code and execution scripts must be pinned by SHA-256 before any data execution
